entries.title: Psalms 19:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament shows His handiwork.

entries.title: Psalms 19:2
segments: Day unto day utters speech, And night unto night reveals knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 19:3
segments: [There is] no speech nor language [Where] their voice is not heard.

entries.title: Psalms 19:4
segments: Their line has gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,

entries.title: Psalms 19:5
segments: Which [is] like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, [And] rejoices like a strong man to run its race.

entries.title: Psalms 19:6
segments: Its rising [is] from one end of heaven, And its circuit to the other end; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.

entries.title: Psalms 19:7
segments: ¶The law of the LORD [is] perfect, converting the soul; The testimony of the LORD [is] sure, making wise the simple;

entries.title: Psalms 19:8
segments: The statutes of the LORD [are] right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the LORD [is] pure, enlightening the eyes;

entries.title: Psalms 19:9
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the LORD [are] true [and] righteous altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 19:10
segments: More to be desired [are they] than gold, Yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

entries.title: Psalms 19:11
segments: Moreover by them Your servant is warned, [And] in keeping them [there is] great reward.

entries.title: Psalms 19:12
segments: Who can understand [his] errors? Cleanse me from secret [faults].

entries.title: Psalms 19:13
segments: Keep back Your servant also from presumptuous [sins]; Let them not have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, And I shall be innocent of great transgression.

entries.title: Psalms 19:14
segments: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, O LORD, my strength and my Redeemer.
